sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Small species; head ochraceous, broadly oval, deep. Mandibles rusty, about one third the length of the head capsule, the outer margin nearly straight, the apex slightly incurved, the middle with a long, pointed, forward-directed large tooth. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest and narrowest, closely fused with segment 4; segments 4 and 5 about equal in size, distinctly smaller than segment 6. Measurements: total length 3.50—3.75 mm, head length (mandibles crossed at the tooth, including mandibles) 1.46 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.10 mm, head width (0.91) 1.10 mm, pronotum length 0.29 mm, width 0.64 mm.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), originally in English; the original describes only the soldier, the alate is recorded as Not known, and the worker is not described. OCR problems: total length given as "3-50 - 3-75" (recorded as 3.50—3.75); "head, wide (0.9 l) 1.10", the value in parentheses being OCR-damaged (recorded as 0.91, doubtful); "Pig." is an error for Fig.; in the synonymy line "Monodont ermes" is a word division of Monodontermes. The original states that the condition of Silvestri's type material is unknown. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology section.
